To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of α-cyclodextrins in the modification of CPEs for electroanalytical purposes is a good strategy to obtain electrodes with good electrochemical properties and a high sensitivity for the determination of heavy metals.
the CPE-CDs are useful for the simultaneous determination of Pb(II) and Cd(II) in aqueous solution by means of anodic stripping voltammeter.
the β-cyclodextin-modified carbon past electrodes are more efficient in the determination of cadmium and lead by anodic stripping voltammety than α-cyclodextrins.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the determination of Pb(II) using anodic stripping voltammerty with a polycyclidextrin-modified electrode.
a new method for the electrochemical determination of Pb(II) in the presence of Cd(II) using CPEα- and β-CD.
a new electroanalytical method for the determination of Pb(II) and Cd(II) using a modified carbon paste electrode with α or β-cyclodexrin.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CPEs modified with β-cyclodextins (CPEβ-CDs) exhibited better analytical responses than those obtained for the CPEs α-cyclodextrins (CPEα-CDS).

the β-cyclodextin-modified electrode (CPEβ-CD), in comparison to the α-cyclodextrins-modified electrode (CEPα-CD), showed a better analytical response in terms of sensitivity and detection limit, which are the main parameters to evaluate the analytical performance of the modified electrode in terms of analytical applications.
the CPEs modified with cyclodextrins can be used as an effective tool to determine simultaneously Pb and Cd by ASV.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CPE modified with β-CD is the electrode with the best analytical performance for the simultaneous determination of Pb(II) y Cd(II) using ASV.
the CPEs modified with cyclodextrins are suitable for the determination of trace amounts of Pb(II) in the presence of Cd(II) and vice versa.
the CPEs modified with cyclodextrins are good electrochemical sensors to determine simultaneously Pb and Cd, with the CPEβ-CDE exhibiting better analytical characteristics than CPEα-ED.
The main takeaway from our work is that
both modified electrodes were able to determine the presence of Pb(II) or Cd(II) in water samples, which is an important contribution to the field of environmental chemistry.
the CPE modified with β-CD was more efficient for the determination of the two metal ions than the CPEα-CDE.
the CPE-CDs are promising for the determination of trace levels of Pb(II) in the presence of Cd(II) in aqueous media.
